title_en: Zhao Zhe — case of manipulating securities trading prices

full_text_en:
Zhao Zhe — Manipulation of Securities Trading Prices

Procuratorial Authority: Shanghai Jing'an District People's Procuratorate.

Defendant: Zhao Zhe, male, 29 years old, native of Shanghai, college degree, transaction settlement clerk in the computer department of Shanghai Lingling Road Securities Trading Business Department of Shijiazhuang Trust & Investment Co., Ltd., arrested on July 1, 1999.

The Shanghai Jing'an District People's Procuratorate instituted a public prosecution against the defendant Zhao Zhe with the charge of manipulation of securities trading prices before the Shanghai Jing'an District People's Court.

The indictment charged that: In order to raise stock prices for the purpose of enabling himself and his friends to profit when selling stocks, the defendant Zhao Zhe used a computer to illegally intrude into the computer information system of Sanya Zhongya Trust & Investment Co., Ltd., Shanghai Xinzha Road Securities Trading Business Department (hereinafter referred to as the Sanya Business Department), and modified the pending order data of that department, thereby raising the prices of two stocks, "Xingye Real Estate" and "Lianhua MSG". Zhao Zhe and his friends took the opportunity to sell stocks, profiting tens of thousands of yuan, while the Sanya Business Department suffered economic losses of over 2.95 million yuan as a result. Zhao Zhe's conduct constituted the crime of manipulation of securities trading prices, which should be punished in accordance with Article 182 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, and he should also be ordered to compensate the injured unit for the economic losses caused.

The defendant Zhao Zhe argued: Regarding the matter that the price of "Lianhua MSG" stock hit the daily limit (i.e., the maximum increase measure taken by the stock exchange when the stock price rises to a certain percentage of the previous day's closing price) at the opening of the afternoon session on April 16, I did not explicitly tell Gao Chunxiu, and his selling of "Lianhua MSG" stock has nothing to do with me.

Defense counsel for Zhao Zhe argued: Zhao Zhe modified the data stored in the computer information system, and his conduct should be punished in accordance with Article 286, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law. The purchase and sale of "Lianhua MSG" stock by Gao Chunxiu has no necessary causal relationship with Zhao Zhe's conduct. Zhao Zhe is a first-time offender with a good attitude in confessing his crime, and he has expressed willingness to compensate the injured unit for the economic losses to the best of his ability. Therefore, Zhao Zhe should be given a lighter punishment and should be granted a suspended sentence. Furthermore, in addition to being related to Zhao Zhe's conduct, the forced liquidation is also a cause of the economic losses suffered by the injured unit. Therefore, Zhao Zhe should not bear all the compensation for these losses.

The Shanghai Jing'an District People's Court found after trial:

The defendant Zhao Zhe had received higher education in electronics and had many years of experience in securities trading, being well-versed in the computer operating procedures of securities trading.

On the afternoon of March 31, 1999, the defendant Zhao Zhe went to the business hall of the injured unit, the Sanya Business Department, and by operating a computer terminal dedicated to client information inquiries, illegally intruded into the computer information system of the Sanya Business Department. He discovered that the order database in the system was not password-protected, and thus conceived the idea of modifying the data in the database to raise the prices of listed stocks, so that he could profit when selling stocks. On April 15, Zhao Zhe again intruded into the computer information system of the Sanya Business Department through its computer, first copying the order database and then conducting simulated modifications to it. After the modifications succeeded, Zhao Zhe decided to implement them the following day. To show off his "ability" to manipulate stock market trends, Zhao Zhe suggested that investor Gao Chunxiu purchase "Lianhua MSG" stocks in advance, so that when the stock price rose, he could sell them for profit.

During the market break at noon on April 16, the defendant Zhao Zhe, in the business hall of the Sanya Business Department, modified the contents of the pending order data that the Sanya Business Department intended to transmit to the stock exchange. He modified the data for orders by five investors including Zhou (A), Li, Zhou (B), Yan, and Tu for other stocks into orders to buy 1.9895 million shares of "Xingye Real Estate" and 2.9898 million shares of "Lianhua MSG" at the daily limit prices of that day. When the stock market opened in the afternoon, these modified data were sent to the stock exchange by the Sanya Business Department, immediately causing the prices of "Xingye Real Estate" and "Lianhua MSG" stocks to rise sharply. Zhao Zhe took the opportunity to sell 7,800 shares of "Xingye Real Estate" stock held in his account at the Shanghai Securities Business Department of Tianjin International Investment Company, realizing a profit of RMB 7,277.01. Investors Gao Chunxiu and his agent Wang Qihua also sold 89,000 shares of "Lianhua MSG" stock that Gao had purchased at Zhao Zhe's suggestion, realizing a profit of over RMB 84,000. As investors holding these two stocks took the opportunity to sell, the Sanya Business Department, which had issued the buy orders, was forced to purchase the stocks at or near the daily limit prices, requiring funds of over RMB 60 million. The Sanya Business Department was unable to pay this huge amount of funds on the spot and was ultimately forced to liquidate positions, suffering economic losses of over RMB 2.95 million. After the case was uncovered, the public security authorities recovered over RMB 400,000 in economic losses for the Sanya Business Department.

To prove the above allegations, the prosecutor submitted the following evidence:

1. The defendant Zhao Zhe's resume and certification materials from his former workplaces confirmed: Zhao Zhe graduated from Shanghai Second Polytechnic University with a major in applied electronics, and had worked successively in two securities trading units, being familiar with computer operations in the securities industry. Zhao Zhe's confession also corroborated the above facts.

2. The Sanya Business Department's report filed on April 16, 1999 and its "Analysis Report" dated April 19 confirmed: After inspecting its computer system, the Sanya Business Department found that the order database had been repeatedly intruded by "hackers" on March 31, April 15, and April 16. The "Analysis Report" also reflected that on April 15, the "hacker" had copied the database and performed deletions and modifications. The defendant Zhao Zhe's confession was consistent with the above.

The account statement from the Shanghai Securities Business Department of Tianjin International Trust and Investment Company confirmed: The defendant Zhao Zhe held 7,800 shares of "Xingye Real Estate" stock in that account. This corroborated Zhao Zhe's confession that he wanted to reduce losses when selling the 7,800 shares of "Xingye Real Estate" stock he had previously purchased.

After inspecting the computer system of the Sanya Business Department, the Computer Technology Department of the Shanghai Stock Exchange provided an analysis, and the testimony of Zhou Bin, a computer operator at the Sanya Business Department, confirmed: The order database of the Sanya Business Department's computer system was not password-protected, and anyone with general computer knowledge and familiarity with the characteristics of the securities industry's computer systems could intrude and modify the data. The confirmed facts were consistent with the defendant Zhao Zhe's confession.

The record of investigative experiments conducted by the Shanghai Public Security Bureau Jing'an Branch and the appraisal document issued by the Third Research Institute of the Ministry of Public Security titled "Conclusion on the Feasibility of Intruding and Modifying Data in the Order Database of the Sanya Business Department's Computer System" were consistent with the Sanya Business Department's "Analysis Report" and the defendant Zhao Zhe's confession.

3. The results of the Sanya Business Department's inspection of its computer system, the on-site surveillance videotape from April 16, and the identification results of the persons in the surveillance videotape by Wang Yang and Liu Jingya, colleagues of the defendant Zhao Zhe at his work unit, confirmed: Zhao Zhe visited the business hall of the Sanya Business Department at noon on April 16, used a computer to intrude into the computer information system, and modified the pending order data for orders by the five investors Zhou (A), Li, Zhou (B), Yan, and Tu for other stocks.

Comparison of the original order data inquiry slips of the five investors with the modified data confirmed: The original data for orders by investors Zhou (A) and Li to buy and sell "Shenneng Shares" and "Fenghua Round Ball" on April 16 were modified to orders to buy 999,000 shares and 990,500 shares of "Xingye Real Estate" at the daily limit price of RMB 10.93; the original data for orders by investors Zhou (B), Yan, and Tu to buy and sell "Jinjian Rice Industry", "Suibao Thermal Power", and "Fujian Cement" on April 16 were modified to orders to buy 999,900 shares, 990,300 shares, and 999,600 shares of "Lianhua MSG" at the daily limit price of RMB 12.98. The content of the modifications to the order data of the five investors was consistent with the defendant Zhao Zhe's confession.

4. The statement of investor Gao Chunxiu confirmed: The defendant Zhao Zhe told him on April 14 that "Lianhua MSG" stock would hit the daily limit on the afternoon of April 16 and that he could buy some. Therefore, on April 15 he instructed his agent Wang Qihua to purchase 79,000 shares of "Lianhua MSG" stock, and Wang Qihua herself also purchased 10,000 shares of the same stock. Gao Chunxiu's statement was corroborated by Wang Qihua's testimony. The testimonies of Gao Chunxiu and Wang Qihua also confirmed: On the afternoon of April 16, before the market opened, they placed orders to sell the "Lianhua MSG" stock purchased on April 15 at the daily limit price. Zhao Zhe confessed that he had told Gao Chunxiu to buy some "Lianhua MSG" stocks in advance.

5. The Sanya Business Department's report and the settlement documents of the five investors, the statement of Sun Chunjiao, a financial officer at the Sanya Business Department, regarding the economic losses suffered by the unit, the settlement document for Zhao Zhe's sale of "Xingye Real Estate" stock, and the testimonies of investor Gao Chunxiu and his agent Wang Qihua confirmed: After Zhao Zhe illegally modified the data, he telephoned the Shanghai Securities Business Department of Tianjin International Trust and Investment Company to sell the 7,800 shares of "Xingye Real Estate" stock under his name; the modified data were sent to the exchange when the market opened on the afternoon of the same day, and the prices of both stocks soon rose to the daily limit, causing abnormal fluctuations in the prices and trading volumes of these two stocks; nearly 5 million shares of the two stocks, with a total value of over RMB 60 million, were purchased by the Sanya Business Department, ultimately leading to forced liquidation and causing the business department economic losses of over RMB 2.95 million; after deducting the portion of losses recovered by the public security authorities, more than RMB 2.4 million remained unrecoverable. At the same time, these evidences also reflected that Zhao Zhe, Gao Chunxiu, and others took the opportunity to sell stocks and profited.

The above evidence was examined and cross-examined in court, and can serve as the basis for determining the facts of this case.

The Shanghai Jing'an District People's Court held:

With the economic and technological development of our country, computers have been widely used in all areas of social life. At the same time, various computer-related crimes have gradually increased, becoming a factor of social instability. Therefore, punishing all types of crimes involving and using computers according to law has become an important task of criminal law.

The defendant Zhao Zhe, as a securities industry practitioner, should have consciously complied with the securities management system and maintained the order of securities transactions. However, in order to enable himself and his friends to sell their stocks at high prices and obtain illegal benefits, he used the method of modifying data stored in a computer information system to artificially manipulate stock prices, disrupting the order of stock market transactions and causing huge economic losses to the Sanya Business Department, with serious circumstances. Zhao Zhe's conduct violated Article 182, paragraph 1, item (4) of the Criminal Law and constituted the crime of manipulation of securities trading prices, for which he should bear criminal responsibility according to law. In accordance with Article 64 of the Criminal Law, Zhao Zhe's illegal gains of RMB 7,277.01 should be recovered. In accordance with Article 36, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, Zhao Zhe should compensate the economic losses caused to the injured unit, the Sanya Business Department.

Article 286, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law stipulates: "Whoever, in violation of state regulations, deletes, modifies, or adds data and application programs stored, processed, or transmitted in a computer information system, if the consequences are serious," constitutes the crime of disrupting computer information systems. The object of this crime is the security protection system established by the state for computer information systems. Article 182 of the Criminal Law stipulates: "Whoever, under any of the following circumstances, manipulates securities trading prices to obtain illegitimate interests or transfer risks, if the circumstances are serious," constitutes the crime of manipulation of securities trading prices, and item (4) lists "using other methods to manipulate securities trading prices" as one of the criminal circumstances. The object of this crime is the state's securities management system and the legitimate rights and interests of investors. Looking at the entirety of the defendant Zhao Zhe's conduct, on the surface it involved illegally intruding into another person's computer information system, modifying data stored in another person's computer information system, and causing damage to part of the information in another person's computer information system. These superficial appearances are similar to the criminal conduct described in Article 286, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law. However, Zhao Zhe did not commit the crime with the purpose of destroying the security protection system established by the state for computer information systems; his subjective intent was to sell stocks for profit when the stock prices rose abnormally. Objectively, his conduct caused abnormal fluctuations in stock market prices, and the result was that he and his friends obtained benefits, while the Sanya Business Department suffered losses of over RMB 2.95 million. Although the means used by Zhao Zhe in his crime implicated a violation of Article 286, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law, the object of his infringement was the state's securities management system and the legitimate rights and interests of investors, which are protected by Article 182 of the Criminal Law. Therefore, his conduct constituted the crime of manipulation of securities trading prices, not the crime of disrupting computer information systems. The charge brought by the procuratorial authority is valid.

Investor Gao Chunxiu purchased tens of thousands of shares of "Lianhua MSG" stock on April 15 and placed orders to sell at the daily limit price before the afternoon session opened on April 16, and the price at which he placed the order matched the daily limit price that appeared after the market opened. Therefore, Gao Chunxiu's testimony that the defendant Zhao Zhe had told him to buy the stock is credible. The court does not accept Zhao Zhe's defense that Gao Chunxiu's sale of the stock had nothing to do with him, nor does it accept the defense opinion of Zhao Zhe's counsel that there was no necessary causal relationship between Gao Chunxiu's purchase and sale of "Lianhua MSG" stock and Zhao Zhe's conduct.

Because the defendant Zhao Zhe modified the data, the injured unit, the Sanya Business Department, sent out erroneous buy orders, thereby suffering economic losses. On the surface, it appears that the Sanya Business Department suffered losses due to being forced to liquidate positions because of its inability to pay, but the fundamental cause was Zhao Zhe's conduct in disrupting the stock market. Zhao Zhe should bear responsibility for all the economic losses suffered by the Sanya Business Department. The defense opinion of Zhao Zhe's counsel that forced liquidation was one of the causes of the economic losses, and therefore Zhao Zhe should not bear all the compensation for these losses, is not accepted.

Although the defendant Zhao Zhe is a first-time offender, his criminal means were heinous, his conduct was highly harmful to society, and the vast majority of the economic losses caused to the injured unit have not yet been recovered. Therefore, the defense opinion of Zhao Zhe's counsel that a suspended sentence should be granted to Zhao Zhe is not accepted. Given that Zhao Zhe's attitude in confessing his crime after being brought to justice is relatively good, he may be given a lighter punishment at discretion.

In summary, in order to maintain the normal management order of the securities market and punish the criminal conduct of manipulating securities trading prices, the Shanghai Jing'an District People's Court rendered the following judgment on November 11, 1999:

1. The defendant Zhao Zhe is convicted of the crime of manipulation of securities trading prices and is sentenced to three years of fixed-term imprisonment, and is also fined RMB 10,000.

2. The defendant Zhao Zhe shall compensate the injured unit, Sanya Zhongya Trust & Investment Co., Ltd., Shanghai Xinzha Road Securities Trading Business Department, for economic losses in the amount of RMB 2,497,604.62.

3. The defendant Zhao Zhe's illegal gains of RMB 7,277.01 are to be recovered and confiscated.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, the defendant Zhao Zhe stated that he accepted the judgment and did not appeal. The procuratorial authority did not file a protest. The first-instance judgment became legally effective.
